rules.cwe_name: Out-of-bounds Read
rules.description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
rules.description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.
